heroSubtitle: Critical access hospitals, FQHCs, and community health centers run lean — which is exactly why AI matters for them, and exactly why generic AI consulting doesn't fit. We bring right-sized strategy, training, and implementation to rural and community health.

challenge.title: Rural health can't afford
challenge.description: Workforce shortages, thin margins, and heavy administrative burden hit rural and community health hardest. AI can ease all three — but most rural organizations don't have an informaticist, an AI budget line, or time for a two-year transformation program. They need a partner who's actually worked in their world.
challenge.bottomText: That's the work we've built our practice around.
